post.description:
Returns the indicative output for a confidential withdraw without
signing or submitting. Read-only.

Applies the same gates as the real confidential withdraw, in the same
order: `to` is required (400 without it), then the policy decision over
the same canonical op (403 when frozen or denied), then the upstream
quote. A wallet whose policy requires approval still gets its quote —
the op is executable once approvers sign.

amount_out.description:
Expected output in minimal units. Absent on a confidential
swap-quote or withdraw dry-run when 1Click gave no estimate for the
route; `hint` then says so. Such an answer is final for the route:
asking again quotes the same way.

min_amount_out.description: Minimum guaranteed output (after slippage). Absent together with `amount_out`.

hint.description: Present only when `amount_out` is absent, and says why.
